name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
🧹 Auto Cache Cleaner & Zero Residual Storage: Immediate post-download cleanup eliminates cache buildup (down from 100+ MB to 0 MB) automatically without manual action.
🚀 Low-End Device RAM & Hardware Acceleration: Highly optimized 565 bitmap decoding and hardware acceleration drastically lowers memory footprint for ultra-smooth performance.
🔌 Adobe CEP In-Process Daemon: Repackaged background service with zero external Node dependency and instant offline queueing to eliminate analysis timeouts.
📁 Custom Folder Naming & Cloud Tree Preservation: Seamless nested folder hierarchy maintained in AE/PR project panels and disk.
📦 Subfolder Preservation in ZIP: Preserves nested folder directories inside .ZIP archives for clean one-click extraction.
